outcome_scope_checks.t4_primary: FAIL correctly reported: cubic 0.04036348805980258 versus selected power 0.03719128753665906, gain -8.529418402137105%. No mathematical or biological superiority claim. The matched-budget comparator gives the same Brier error and FAIL decision.
outcome_scope_checks.villin_stress: FAIL correctly retained separately: cubic 0.019960005333488316 versus power 0.015995172162488375, gain -24.78768675%; no independent-campaign or population claim.
outcome_scope_checks.all_scenarios: All 16 prespecified rows are present. Rounded values and signs were verified against raw test aggregate JSON, including the tiny positive Villin jitter050 advantage and tiny negative T4 jitter025 effect. No favorable-scenario substitution.
outcome_scope_checks.same_scale_threshold: Actual T4 prose explicitly separates cubic-selected t=16 and its same-t linear comparator (zero disagreements) from independently tuned linear/power t=8. Villin same-t monotonicity is also explained.
outcome_scope_checks.coverage: The report explicitly gives selected-feature positive-cell coverage and total omitted coverage: T4 approximately 63.3229% retained and 36.6771% omitted, alongside the 0.1983% discovery-constant-absent subset. Newly appearing contacts are not represented as all omitted dynamics.
outcome_scope_checks.inference: Noise-only intervals are conditional, pointwise and unadjusted. No protein-population significance, experimental functional claim, kinetics inference, or biological replication from frames, contacts or noise draws is claimed.
outcome_scope_checks.mathematical_attribution: The binary expected-median construction is linked accurately to OpenAI #332; prior cubic attribution to Cheng/Wang/Xiang is retained. Metric cotype and metric Markov cotype are not conflated. The theorem does not guarantee Brier improvement.
outcome_scope_checks.data_identity: The exact deposited T4 sequence is retained without a wild-type label. Engineered HP35 NLE65/HSP68/NLE70 is retained; no unverified exact starting PDB or simulation pH is claimed.
outcome_scope_checks.excluded_ubiquitin: There is no temporal benchmark result. The original-run mapping exclusion is bounded to inspected provenance. The published structural ensemble is not described as invalid.
outcome_scope_checks.rights: Villin and ubiquitin CC BY 4.0 were confirmed by primary APIs; the T4 license field is absent, and no blanket public redistribution grant is claimed.
